name: Versa
description: Energetic textures and patterns are integral characteristics of this versatile collection. Each of these modern borderless patterns is hand knotted using a combination of premium hand-spun wool and Silkette™ in a pile-and-loop weave that gives each design its distinctive textural look and feel.

name: Angola
description: Angola is a classic design with a timely twist. The sizeable yarn accentuates the simple yet bold construction. Multiple colors of undyed wool work together to create the chunky herringbone. The colorful accent stripe brings this design to life. Rich camel and fresh taupe diversify these offerings. This stylish flatweave would stand out on a staircase or in a family room.

name: Arrieta
description: Arrieta is an architecturally impactful flatweave with beautiful structure and refined style. Craft and artistry define this fine rib weave. The gorgeous subtle color range lends itself to a multitude of applications. The dynamic combination of natural wools and nylon-blended yarn accentuates the overall texture.

name: Aster Grove
description: This chic horizontal stripe is a breath of fresh air. Fine color accents add zest to the dynamic loop pile, creating a lively rhythm across the surface. Hand-loomed from premium wool, this design combines modern flair with timeless craftsmanship, ensuring that its beauty and durability will enhance any room for years to come.

name: Bamburi
description: Sister product to Xanadu, Bamburi is a classic geometric. A hint of distressing runs through the diamond patterning to give it some visual interest. Perfect for any room, from nursery to family room. A diverse color range really sets this design apart. Its competitive pricing and timeless look give this flatweave the edge it needs to triumph in the market.

name: Breckenridge
description: Introducing Breckenridge, a captivating blend of natural and dyed wools, exquisitely hand-loomed into a stylish flatweave. Its updated plaid design redefines tradition and features a vibrant red and cobalt color in the line. The perfect harmony of timeless craftsmanship and contemporary charm, Breckenridge elevates any space with its striking design.

name: Adara
description: Imagine the softness of New Zealand wool cradling your feet with every step, while the subtle sheen of lustrous nylon catches the light, creating a visual dance of texture and tone. This masterfully crafted flatwoven carpet is more than just flooring, it is a statement of elegance, blending the timeless quality of wool with the sleek sophistication of nylon

name: Mirage Cheetah
description: Animal skins complement a vast array of decorating styles; thus, their popularity is ever increasing. Mirage Cheetah features a stylized small scale animal pattern. With its fine needle point loops and intricate pattern structure, wire wilton is one of our most luxurious constructions. Bright blues, and soft yellows invigorate the color range. Tonal striations accentuate this subtle yet dressy aesthetic.

name: Barcelona Bliss
description: This upscale texture has a sophisticated fabric-inspired aesthetic, exuding elegance and refinement. Vibrant colorations make it timely and posh, perfect for elevating modern interiors. Crafted from a luxurious blend of wool and nylon, this piece not only enhances your space with beauty but also offers the strength and durability needed to maintain its charm for years to come.

name: Audrey
description: Audrey takes center stage with her eye-catching all-over chic wire-wilton texture. The linear structure emphasized by brilliantly smart colors, seamlessly fade in and out creating a kaleidoscopic allure. A true star of the show with a timeless sensibility and enduring style.

name: Axis
description: Flawless, polished, classic. Stantons wire wilton, Axis, is all three of these and more. The lofty loops and floats that define the Crossroads Collection give the design the right dimension needed to accentuate and emphasize this larger-scaled chevron pattern. A subtle accent stripe runs down the length of this wilton for an added decorative touch. The tonal strie cleverly tones down the colors for a light and airy feel. Done in the freshest lineup of colors, Axis is a knockout.

name: Bimini
description: Biminis felted wool and fiber dyed polysilk yarn work together perfectly to create this handsome sisal inspired design. Heathered yarns add a hint of texture. This structured weave will be sure to make its presence known in the marketplace

name: Brigitte
description: We are taking this traditional trellis design and updating it with a modern twist. The classic small scale geometric lends itself to a variety of design sensibilities. The charming motif and tasteful wire-wilton construction, coupled with a thrilling color range make Brigitte a rising star.

name: Cameroon
description: A refined, organic flooring option crafted from durable agave fibers. Natural sisal offers a clean, textured look in soft neutral tones—ideal for stair runners, wall-to-wall installations, and high-traffic areas. Its structured weave and understated elegance make it a preferred choice for sophisticated, design-driven interiors.

name: Collins
description: Elevate any space with Collins, a timeless expression of classic geometry and refined craftsmanship. Its all-loop pile construction, woven in a precise Wire Wilton technique, brings the subtle elegance of a wicker-inspired design to life-enhanced by a random strie ground and a fresh, modern palette. The luxurious wool/nylon blend offers both softness and strength, making Collins as enduring as it is enchanting.

name: Demetrius
description: Demetrius is a modern interpretation of a classic greek key. The structured loops define the design, and the intriguing construction adds a refined undertone. Setting the design on an angle adds to the interest and makes Demetrius a standout pattern. Exciting new colors bolster this wiltons much anticipated popularity.

name: Felix
description: We have never met a leopard we did not love and Felix is one of our favorites. New color introductions give this timeless design a whole new look! We look forward to seeing these new colors in bedrooms and living rooms near you.

name: Lysander
description: Flawless, polished, classic. Stantons wire wilton, Lysander, is all three of these and more. The lofty loops and floats that define the Midsummer Collection give the design the right dimension needed to accentuate and emphasize this larger-scaled chevron pattern. A subtle accent stripe runs down the length of this wilton for an added decorative touch. The tonal strie cleverly tones down the colors for a light and airy feel. Done in the freshest lineup of colors, Lysander is a knockout.

name: Marilyn
description: Vibrant, bold, and sophisticated, Marilyn is a showstopper. Her stylish vertical lines flaunt the prismatic palettes as they move gracefully across the width of this sublime Wire Wilton. Crafted from a luxurious blend of wool and nylon, Marilyns design embodies both elegance and long-lasting durability, making her perfect for any glamorous interior.

name: Morrison
description: Morrison is a perennial wire wilton creation that marries traditional craftsmanship with present-day charm. Its small-scale geometric pattern is enriched by a delicate strie effect, showcasing distinct colorways, including vibrant cobalt blue, soft pink, light blue, and a unique multi-colored option. This wool blend masterpiece adds a polished, modern flair to any room.

name: Theseus
description: Theseus is artisanal luxury at its best. The horizontal rib, done in lofty wire wilton construction takes age old tradition and transforms it into now. The radiant striations spotlight the fine needle point loops. A jewel in the market, Theseus adds urban refinement to the category.

name: Tillary
description: We are taking this traditional trellis design and updating it with a modern twist. The classic small scale geometric lends itself to a variety of design sensibilities. The charming motif and tasteful wire-wilton construction, coupled with a thrilling color range make Tillary a rising star.

name: Waveside
description: Whether in a sunroom or by the pool, this lofty chic loop texture is a winning choice. Its cheerful colorations spread warmth and joy, effortlessly withstanding the elements and adding a touch of elegance to any outdoor retreat. That is a winning combination.
